note: Weekly per-game PPR projections: season ppg x opponent def-vs-pos multiplier (2025 PPR allowed/gm vs league avg, shrunk 40%, clamped [0.82,1.18]) x home/away (1.02/0.98), normalized to mean 1.0 per team so weeks sum to the season line. null = bye. Points assume the player plays; gp carries the season games discount. Half/Std: pts - 0.5*rec or pts - rec, where weekly rec scales with the same multiplier (rec_w = recPG * pts_w / ppg).
